channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Patrick Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Patrick Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Deni Avdija on Patrick Williams
item.description:
Deni Avdija:

“Everybody thought Chicago was going to take me at No. 4. It made the most sense. Then, when Chicago drafted Patrick Williams, it was a surprise because nobody really thought about him going fourth. Once that happened, the draft got messy. It became, ‘He’s available, he’s available,’ and you know how it is. I ended up thinking, ‘Man, I’m really going to New York at No. 8.’ As a Jewish guy in New York, that could have been crazy. Then they chose someone else, and I was like, ‘Okay, D.C., here we go.’ I don’t know if I would have wanted New York in my first year. There would have been a lot of distractions, I think.”

Deni Avdija on Patrick Williams, Apr 15, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Josh Giddey on Patrick Williams
item.description:
KC Johnson:Josh Giddey on Bulls:

“Very talented team and they've got a lot of guys---Zach, DeMar, Coby was awesome, really emerged last year,Pat Williams, the young guys Ayo and Dalen. I'm looking forward to trying to immerse in it and not take away from anybody.”

Josh Giddey on Patrick Williams, Jun 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Patrick Williams
item.description:
Alex Caruso on Patrick Williams:

“He’s one of the nicest guys I’ve ever been around as a teammate. He wants everybody else to be OK and be right. And he’s the one who can’t get right right now. So we’re feeling for him and we’re there for him.”

Alex Caruso on Patrick Williams, Feb 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Javonte Green, Patrick Williams
item.description:
Alex Caruso on Patrick Williams wearing his jersey and Javonte Green donning a headband to celebrate his return:

“We have great chemistry. I think everybody on the team is pulling for whoever it is at the time that needs it. And tonight it was me.”

Alex Caruso on Javonte Green, Patrick Williams, Mar 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Nikola Vucevic on Patrick Williams
item.description:
Nikola Vucevic:

“Patrick is a big part of what we do. We’re going to miss him a lot, especially defensively.”

Nikola Vucevic on Patrick Williams, Oct 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Patrick Williams
item.description:
Sean Devaney:Erik Spoelstra on @Chicago Bulls Patrick Williams:

“He is set up in the future to be a great two-way basketball player, to be able to defend virtually everybody on the floor, whatever your scheme may be.”

Erik Spoelstra on Patrick Williams, Jul 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @SeanDeveney.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Patrick Williams
item.description:
KC Johnson:Billy Donovan on whether Patrick Williams could start regular season opener:

“I think keeping an open mind to that is not out of the question.”

Billy Donovan on Patrick Williams, Dec 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.
